ADR-017 (internal): Move async exports from request thread to queued pipeline with S3 handoff. Excerpt: Decision: all exports above 10k rows run async via queue workers with idempotency keys. Rationale: p95 request latency was 2.8s and timed out under concurrent exports; async pipeline isolates heavy I/O and allows retry semantics. Consequence: adds operational complexity (queue monitoring), but reduced export-related API timeouts from 4.2% to 0.3%.

I owned an initiative to add an AI-generated next best action panel to the sales dashboard, expecting it to improve rep follow-up rates. Adoption looked good in week 1, but conversion to booked meetings stayed flat (11.2% to 11.4%), and interviews showed reps did not trust low-context suggestions. I had optimized for model output quality, but not for explainability and workflow fit. If I did it again, I would run a smaller pilot first, include confidence and explanation UI from day one, and gate rollout on a metric tied to actual pipeline movement, not just feature clicks.
